'''Xer VIII's father''' was the father of [[Xer VIII]] and grandfather of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. In the historical play ''[[The Pirate Prince]]'', Xer suggests that his father was unfaithful to [[Xer VIII's mother|his wife]], and also suggests that he killed his own father for the infidelity.
